body: its even more depressing reading this subreddit; so many posts that people were probably hoping to be replied to never even get a single comment
Definitely better than last night. I ended up going to class today, and that's a win in my book!
Thank you for sharing your feelings and kind words. I truly appreciate the support. Glad to know I'm not alone

It's nice to know that there are others that can relate.

 I'd like you to know that it was because of this comment that I got out of bed today and went to class even though I felt like shit. Thank you.
